annotations.text:
Plumb — News Centre, Android

Tokens lifted from mobile/lib/theme.ts, not approximated.
Newsreader for the brand and the lead headline, Manrope for
the interface, Geist Mono for anything a reader compares
down a column.

Colour is spent on two things only: the sector dot beside a
source, and importance. Everything else is set in type.

An empty section is a dead end the app chose to open on.
It says what is missing and offers both a wider window and
the section that does have something.

Saved and Upcoming drop the date window: one holds things
you put there deliberately, the other is dated forwards.
Showing a window selected would imply it applied.
